State EN: Man RIGHT palm waves directly beneath the exposed tail without contact. The single manual dispenser and paper remain still; heroine hands stay clear.
狀態: 男子右掌在露出紙尾正下方揮，不接觸。唯一手動紙巾盒與紙保持不動；女主雙手未碰。
Acting EN: Man watches the unmoving paper tail with an expectant concentrated brow while RIGHT palm waves directly underneath; heroine observes the useless wave neutrally. Both mouths stay softly closed; no speech-shaped pose.
表演: 男子右掌在紙尾正下方揮，期待地皺眉看不動的紙。女主中性地觀察無效揮手。 兩人嘴唇自然輕閉，不作說話口型。

State EN: Man LEFT palm gives the second compact wave beneath the same unchanged paper tail. No sensor, motor, or extra paper appears.
狀態: 男子左掌在同一不動紙尾下方短促揮第二次。不出現感應器、馬達或多餘紙。
Acting EN: Man gives the LEFT-hand wave with a more puzzled brow, lips closed; heroine's eyes shift from his palm to the exposed paper edge, one slight brow lift. Both mouths stay softly closed; no speech-shaped pose.
表演: 男子換左掌揮，眉心更疑惑、嘴仍閉。女主由他的手掌看向露出的紙邊，只輕挑眉。 兩人嘴唇自然輕閉，不作說話口型。

State EN: Man has lowered both hands. Heroine LEFT fingers approach the lower paper edge, RIGHT hand near the upper section/slot; paper remains connected.
狀態: 男子雙手已放低。女主左手指靠近紙下緣，右手在上方或底槽附近；紙仍連著。
Acting EN: With his hands down, man looks at her approaching paper grip; heroine's eyes focus exactly on the paper edge, no smile. Both mouths stay softly closed; no speech-shaped pose.
表演: 男子雙手已放低，目光看她將握紙的手；女主眼睛專注紙邊，尚未笑。 兩人嘴唇自然輕閉，不作說話口型。

State EN: Heroine LEFT grips the lower edge and RIGHT steadies near slot/perforation. Sheet is under a controlled pull but still visibly connected to roll.
狀態: 女主左手握下緣，右手穩住槽或虛線撕口附近。紙受控制拉動，仍明顯連捲。
Acting EN: Heroine stays calmly focused on the connected sheet under her two hands; man's brows begin to lift as he notices the manual pull. Both mouths stay softly closed; no speech-shaped pose.
表演: 女主平靜專注雙手間仍連著的紙。男子看見手動拉紙，眉毛開始輕抬。 兩人嘴唇自然輕閉，不作說話口型。

State EN: One elongated rectangle is detached and held by LEFT at its upper corner after a visible two-hand regrip. RIGHT is free; short next tail remains.
狀態: 清楚雙手換握後，一張修長長方形已分開，由左手握其上角。右手空出，下一短紙尾保留。
Acting EN: Man looks at the single detached towel with a small realization brow lift; heroine checks the sheet calmly, without presenting it theatrically. Both mouths stay softly closed; no speech-shaped pose.
表演: 男子看一張已取下紙巾，輕抬眉恍然大悟。女主平靜確認紙張，不誇張展示。 兩人嘴唇自然輕閉，不作說話口型。

State EN: LEFT holds the same intact rectangle by its upper corner above the clear foreground counter. RIGHT is free; the same short next tail stays in the slot.
狀態: 左手握同一完整長方形的上角，停在空前景檯面上方。右手空出，底槽保留同一短紙尾。
Acting EN: Her gaze stays on the sheet and clear landing area. Man starts glancing from the useful paper toward his own previously waving palm, no renewed waving. Both mouths stay softly closed; no speech-shaped pose.
表演: 女主看紙張與空著的放紙處。男子開始由有用的紙看自己的揮手掌，不再揮動。 兩人嘴唇自然輕閉，不作說話口型。

State EN: Same sheet now lies flat on the counter and both heroine hands are empty in her own space. Man keeps his own hands separate from hers.
狀態: 同一張紙已平放檯面，女主雙手在自己範圍空出。男子的手與她的手分開。
Acting EN: Man studies his own empty palm, lips briefly pressed and shoulders relaxed in mild embarrassment; heroine has a tiny earned smile, hands safely in her own space. Both mouths stay softly closed; no speech-shaped pose.
表演: 男子看自己空掌，短暫抿嘴、肩膀放鬆，略感尷尬。女主這時才微笑，雙手留自己空間。 兩人嘴唇自然輕閉，不作說話口型。

State EN: Two empty heroine flat palms meet at lower sternum for the small bow. Sheet stays flat in the same position; next tail stays in the slot.
狀態: 女主兩隻空手於胸骨下方平貼合掌、小幅鞠躬。紙留原位平放，下一紙尾留槽。
Acting EN: Heroine's small bow has soft eyes and a calm mouth; man keeps hands to himself. The flat paper and exposed next tail stay clearly visible. Both mouths stay softly closed; no speech-shaped pose.
表演: 女主小幅鞠躬，眼神柔和、嘴角平靜。男子不伸手碰她。平放紙巾和下一截紙尾仍清楚可見。 兩人嘴唇自然輕閉，不作說話口型。
